### Edom's Fall and Israel's Rise
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/edoms-fall-and-israels-rise
Passage: Obadiah 1:15-21
Points:
- Obadiah reassures God's displaced people that exile and suffering are not their final destination.
- The Day of the Lord brings decisive divine intervention, executing judgment on oppressors while rescuing the faithful remnant.
- Edom's downfall in history points ahead to the final judgment and the universal reign of God.
- Rather than leaving His people to condemnation, God sent Christ to endure the Day of the Lord on their behalf.
- Believers await the full consummation of their inheritance, when they will share in Christ's everlasting kingdom.

### Devotional: Obadiah
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/1-chronicles-16-james-3-obadiah-luke-5/
Passage: Obadiah 1:15-21
Points:
- God's justice is central to Obadiah, demonstrating that arrogance and malicious gloating over others will not escape retribution.
- The warning in verse 15 applies globally: the Day of the Lord ensures that wrongdoing will return upon the perpetrators' heads.
- Temporal judgments in human history serve as prophetic warnings of the ultimate, universal divine judgment to come.
- True world hope rests in the future of God's covenant people, culminating in the reality that the kingdom belongs to the Lord.
